Class Database

java.lang.Object
io.baleia.trino.catalogstore.Database
public class Database extends Object
PostgreSQL data access layer for trino_catalog_registry and trino_clusters.

Uses PGSimpleDataSource directly (no connection pool — see design decisions in README). Each operation acquires a fresh connection, executes, and closes it. Transient failures are retried with exponential backoff; permanent failures propagate immediately.

The query contract (tables, columns, SQL) is documented in the "Backend requirements" section of the project README. Each backend owns its own migration; this class only reads and writes a fixed set of columns.

      @Inject public Database(BaleiaCatalogStoreConfig config)
      Creates a new database access layer from the given configuration.

      Configures the PGSimpleDataSource with JDBC URL, credentials, and timeout values. No connection is established at construction time.

      Parameters:
      config - the plugin configuration

  • Method Details

    • loadAll

      public List<CatalogRow> loadAll()
      Loads all enabled catalog rows for the configured cluster.

      Per-row parse or validation failures are logged and marked (sync_status='error') without aborting the load. A connection-level failure retries with backoff, then throws TrinoException to fail the boot.

      Returns:
      list of validated catalog rows, never null

    • loadProperties

      public Optional<Map<String,String>> loadProperties(String catalogName)
      Loads the properties of a single enabled catalog.

      Used by SecretResolver to resolve @baleia-secret[catalog:key] references — one database call per referenced catalog, memoized within a single resolve() invocation.

      Parameters:
      catalogName - the catalog to look up
      Returns:
      the parsed properties, or Optional.empty() if not found

    • upsert

      public void upsert(CatalogRow row, String version)
      Inserts or updates a catalog row via UPSERT.

      Sets sync_status='synced', updated_by='trino', and enabled=true. On conflict (cluster_id, catalog_name), all fields are overwritten.

      Parameters:
      row - the catalog row to persist
      version - the computed catalog version hash

    • softDelete

      public void softDelete(String catalogName)
      Soft-deletes a catalog by setting enabled=false.

      The row remains in the database for audit. The catalog will no longer appear in loadAll() results.

      Parameters:
      catalogName - the catalog to disable

    • markError

      public void markError(String catalogName, String message)
      Best-effort write of a failure marker for a single bad catalog. Visible to BaleiaCatalogStore so eager resolution failures in getCatalogs() can be marked the same way parse failures in loadAll() already are.
